definition: 若有清楚独立的罗纹/扣式/翻折袖口带，框整个袖口带；没有独立带则框袖子末端开口的可见边缘，允许少量余量。各开口单独框；只标目标服装，不标内搭、整条袖子、手表、下摆。遮挡/截断或目标层不清标 ambiguous。
limitations: All source images came from original segmentation training data.
No independent untouched end-to-end test set is established.
Annotations apply only to the specified garment, not every garment in the image.
Ambiguous cases are excluded, never used as empty-label negatives.
No original segmentation label, weight, or protected Core/val manifest is modified.
Original nine development images and cuff labels unchanged.
Supplement contains only new training samples; no independent blind cuff test.
